name: COM Tope Graphs Are Strictly Varchenko-Factorizable
scope: Finite simple COMs and their tope graphs under the survey conventions.
statement: Every COM tope graph has arrangement-type Varchenko factorization, and the containment is strict.
proof: The unsigned COM determinant theorem gives the factorization. The graph $Q_4^{--}(1)$ is not a COM tope graph but has the required factorization.
